question: The theatres screen: country_theatres, its rows theatre_entry and area_entry, topcolor_theatres and selected_theatre - who makes it, how it opens and shuts, each list, each element, every action and what it posts, every tooltip.

addresses.name: CTheatreView::CTheatreView
addresses.comment: The theatres screen's constructor, called once from CInGameIdler_BuildViews (0x259760), the sixth view (index 5 of +0xD00). Base CCountryView with `country_theatres`, `topcolor_theatres` and **view_index 4** - the same index the espionage view passes. Sets +0xC0 = 1, +0xB8/+0xBC = 0 and sizes the vector at +0xC4 to the sub-unit database's count (zeros). Hangs observers on `selected_theatre`'s `build` (the glue at +0xD8, handler CTheatreView::OnBuild, 0x72030) and `goto_button` (+0x104, handler CTheatreView::OnGoto, 0x73320). Size not read.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x46FA00..0x46FD64: the base call at 0x46FA6E with `push 4` at 0x46FA58, the two std::string literals, the two glue vftable writes; ret 8. Refuted by a second writer of vftable 0x15BD424 other than the destructor.

addresses.name: CTheatreView::ScalarDeletingDestructor
addresses.comment: Slot 1, the ordinary scalar deleting destructor: runs 0x6FDA0 and frees when the flag's low bit is set.
addresses.evidence: Slot 1 of 0x15BD424 is 0x46FD70; ret 4. Refuted by it being a different body in another table.

addresses.name: CTheatreView_RefillLists
addresses.comment: **Empties `my_theatres` and `allied_theatres` and makes their rows again.** Looks in the idler's selection (+0x1304, only when its count +0x130C > 0) for the first entry with slot 1 == 0 (a land unit) and oob_level (+0x1F4) == 0 - a selected theatre headquarters. Then, for each CTheatre of the **played** country's own AI strategy (area_theatre, country +0x570) in list order whose headquarters exists (id pair +0x74/+0x78, FindPersistentByIdPair), a CTheatreEntry in `my_theatres`, and the theatre becomes selected (+0xB8/+0xBC = its id pair, +0xC0 = 1) if its headquarters is the selected one **or** nothing is selected yet. Then every country on the player's Allies list (+0xF88), in list order, and each of **their** theatres likewise into `allied_theatres`, chosen only if nothing is selected yet. No sort. A theatre with no headquarters makes no row.
addresses.evidence: Read whole on the listing 0x46FE00..0x4701CC (the decompiler's arguments are wrong, this is in ESI). Refuted by a sort call between the fills; there is none.

addresses.name: CTheatreView::Show
addresses.comment: Slot 2: CTheatreView_RefillLists; +0xC0 = 1; slot 6 (Update) once; shows `topcolor_theatres` (+0xAC) then `country_theatres` (+0xA8); tail-jumps slot 11 (UpdateAutomationLine), which does nothing on this screen because the file declares no `automation_setting`.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x4701D0..0x470212. Refuted by another writer of +0xC0 between the Update and the Show.

addresses.name: CTheatreView_ShowImmediateNeeds
addresses.signature: void __stdcall CTheatreView_ShowImmediateNeeds(CTheatreView* view@stack:4, void* window@stack:8, CUnit* hq@stack:0xC)
addresses.comment: **`immediate_needs` and the `build` button.** The HQ's `plan_subunit_needed` (+0x7C, one int per unit type) is copied into the view's vector at +0xC4 only when its length is the database's; each line of the **played** country's own queue that is a military line (slot 17 true) and aimed at this HQ (target +0x90/+0x94 = HQ +0x10/+0x14) takes `Size` off the entry of every brigade type it holds. If any entry is above nought the text is `<n> £<type key>, ` over all such types in database order, the trailing `, ` taken off (`£` is the counter-in-text escape), and `build` is enabled when the HQ's owner (+0x128) is the played country (slot 46), disabled otherwise (slot 47). Otherwise `immediate_needs` says NO_NEEDS_FOR_BUILDS and `build` is disabled. Text box `immediate_needs`, button `build`.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled and checked against the listing: the size test at the head, the two NO_NEEDS_FOR_BUILDS strings, the separators at 0x15BD2DC (` \xA3`) and `, `. ret 0xC. Refuted by a counted brigade being a CConstruction whose Size is multiplied by something else.

addresses.name: CTheatreView_ShowForces
addresses.comment: **`forces`.** Counts, per unit type, every brigade of every unit on the HQ owner's unit list (+0xBAC) whose CUnit_FindTheatre answers the same theatre as the HQ's; the text is `<n> £<key>, ` over the types with a count above nought, in database order, the trailing `, ` taken off; empty when none.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly: the two calls of CUnit_FindTheatre (0x5D2A00) at 0x470DF9 and 0x470E03 comparing unit and HQ; the `forces` literal; ret 8.

addresses.name: CTheatreView_FillAreas
addresses.signature: void __fastcall CTheatreView_FillAreas(void* window@ECX, CTheatreView* view@stack:4, CUnit* hq@stack:8)
addresses.comment: **`areas`, emptied and refilled**: for each front (CAreaBorder, CTheatre +0x50, list order) of the HQ's theatre that has **at least two provinces** (byte length of +0x8..+0xC above 4) and whose enemy (+0x1C/+0x20) is **not** a friend of the played country (CCountry::IsFriend(player, enemy, true)), a CAreaEntry row, 0x1A0 bytes.
addresses.evidence: Read on the listing 0x4711C0..0x47140A; ret 8; the `4 < byte count` test. Refuted by a province-count test elsewhere.

addresses.name: CTheatreView_ShowObjectives
addresses.comment: **`objective` and `current_operation`.** `objective` = CUnit_ObjectivesSummaryText (0x1B5B50) of the HQ, or the text of NO_OBJECTIVES when that is empty. `current_operation` = for each AI agent of the HQ owner's CEU3AI (agents list at ai +0x50) whose slot 60 gives a non-empty land force: the first land unit whose top HQ's theatre is the HQ's own theatre, and then, where the agent's +0x84 and +0x88 are both set, THEATRE_INVASION with $TARGET$ = province +0x84's name and $STAGE$ = +0x88's. Several agents append with no separator. NO_INVASION_PLAN when nothing matched.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled and read on the listing: the THEATRE_INVASION / TARGET / STAGE pushes at 0x471833..0x471850; ret 8. Slot 60 on anything but a CAIInvasion was not read, so that a non-invasion agent passes empty is inferred.

addresses.name: CTheatreView::Update
addresses.comment: Slot 6. Finds the selected theatre by its id pair (+0xB8/+0xBC). While the screen is open (slot 7): where no theatre was found it takes the first row of `my_theatres`, if any. Only when the theatre is found **and** the dirty byte +0xC0 is set does it clear the byte and fill `selected_theatre`: `title` = the HQ's name (slot 7), `country_icon` shield = the HQ's owner, `land_stance`/`air_stance`/`naval_stance` = PlanStanceName / PlanAirStanceName / PlanNavalStanceName of plan_stance +0x208 / +0x20C / +0x210, then ShowImmediateNeeds, ShowForces, ShowObjectives, FillAreas. Every frame after that it calls every `areas` row's slot 8 (Update) - and only those, the theatre lists' rows are not touched.
addresses.evidence: Read whole on the listing 0x471AD0..0x472004.

addresses.name: CTheatreView::Rebuild
addresses.comment: Slot 0: slot 4 (Hide), CCountryView::Rebuild; on success CTheatreView_RefillLists.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; slot 0 of 0x15BD424.

addresses.name: CTheatreView::OnBuild
addresses.comment: `selected_theatre`'s `build` (glue at +0xD8): +0xD4 = the played country's Manpower, then CTheatreView::BuildStep until it answers false. Nothing refreshes the text afterwards; the needs shown are stale until the screen is reselected or reopened.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; bare ret. No write of +0xC0 in it; refuted by one.

addresses.name: CTheatreView::BuildStep
addresses.comment: **One round of the Build button of the selected theatre**, the twin of _A0x8295b6bf::CAreaEntry::BuildStep (rva 0x6D790), which is the same shape on a row's needs and a manpower local. Over the view's +0xC4 needs: air = sum over is_air types, land = over is_land, ship = over is_ship. If air > land/4: the air type with the highest score of need*5000 + (r % (need*10 + 1))*1000, r from a stack MT19937 whose state is never seeded (need > 0, is_buildable, CountMaxUnitsStillBuildable >= 1; strict, first wins); a series size root = integer square root of the need (Newton from need/2, at least 1); lines = need/root; each line drops root until 2..root is affordable, charges the manpower, posts a CConstructUnitCommand (brigade list [type], province = country +0xE24, amount = the series size, target the HQ) and takes the size off the need. Else land > 2: one division - in database order, first types with priority > 4, then types with priority < 5, needs decremented as they go, up to (BRIGADES_IN_DIVISION + division_size)/1000 brigades (one fewer in the first pass); CanBuildDivision(list, country, 1) true: charge it, post one CConstructUnitCommand, true; false: fall to the single pick below. Else land > 0: the land type picked by the same score, built as air is. Else ships, the same. Answers false when manpower goes below nought or nothing is pickable, true otherwise. The command's owner is the played country, the builder `---`.
addresses.evidence: Structure read off the listing of the twin (0x46D790..0x46E99D) branch by branch (0x46D9BD air test, 0x46DD57 land>2, 0x46E0DD CanBuildDivision, 0x46E232 land>0, 0x46E5DB ships), and the decompilation of both agreeing; the twin's bare `ret` here at 0x472679 etc. Refuted by the two differing in a branch.

addresses.name: CTheatreView::OnGoto
addresses.comment: `selected_theatre`'s `goto_button` (glue at +0x104). Finds the selected theatre and its HQ; **if the HQ is the player's** (slot 2): deselects it first if already selected (slot 45), ClearSelection (46), slot 93, Select(hq) (38), CentreOnProvinceId of the HQ's province (+0x130 province id, slot 47). Then, in every case, closes: if +0xB4 is 0 and a view is open, OpenCountryView(the open view) - the toggle.
addresses.evidence: Read on the listing 0x473320..0x4734C9 with the slot numbers from the vtable offsets. Refuted by another path to the select.

addresses.name: _A0x8295b6bf::CTheatreEntry::CTheatreEntry
addresses.signature: _A0x8295b6bf::CTheatreEntry* __stdcall _A0x8295b6bf::CTheatreEntry::CTheatreEntry(_A0x8295b6bf::CTheatreEntry* this@stack:4, CTheatreView* view@stack:8, CTheatre* theatre@stack:0xC, CInGameIdler* idler@ECX) @EAX
addresses.comment: One row of `my_theatres`/`allied_theatres`, 0x90 bytes, window `theatre_entry`. Keeps the theatre's id pair (+0x80/+0x84), the view (+0x88); calls Refresh and hangs its glue (+0x30, handler OnSelect) on `background_button`.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly; ret 0xC; RTTI vftable writes 0x15BD524 / 0x15BD55C.

addresses.name: _A0x8295b6bf::CTheatreEntry::Refresh
addresses.comment: `title` = the HQ's name (slot 7), `country_icon` shield = the HQ's owner (+0x128), then Update (slot 8) once. Nothing further when the theatre or HQ is gone. Called only from the constructor.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; ret 4.

addresses.name: _A0x8295b6bf::CTheatreEntry::OnSelect
addresses.comment: `background_button`'s handler: where the row's theatre still exists, the view's selection (+0xB8/+0xBC) becomes that theatre's id pair and +0xC0 = 1. Bare ret; nothing else.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled and on the listing; the handler pointer in the constructor.

addresses.name: _A0x8295b6bf::CTheatreEntry::Update
addresses.comment: Slot 8. `theatre_plupp` (three frames) by CUnitPlan::GetPowerRatio of the theatre HQ's plan (+0x1FC) as a float: frame 1 above 0.75, frame 2 above 0.5, else frame 3 (the ratio is -1 when their_power is exactly 0, so frame 3). Called only from Refresh.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; constants 0x17179A8 = 0.75, 0x15AB304 = 0.5, DAT_0160A300 = 1000.0; no other caller of the slot found in this family.

addresses.name: _A0x8295b6bf::CAreaEntry::CAreaEntry
addresses.signature: _A0x8295b6bf::CAreaEntry* __stdcall _A0x8295b6bf::CAreaEntry::CAreaEntry(_A0x8295b6bf::CAreaEntry* this@stack:4, CTheatreView* view@stack:8, CTheatre* theatre@stack:0xC, CAreaBorder* front@stack:0x10, CInGameIdler* idler@ECX) @EAX
addresses.comment: One row of `areas`, 0x1A0 bytes, window `area_entry`. Four observer glues: +0x30 (goto, OnGoto), +0x80 (build, OnBuild), +0xD0 (the stub 0xABF890, **never attached to anything**), +0x120 (stance, OnStance). Keeps the theatre id pair (+0x170/+0x174), view (+0x178), front (+0x17C), +0x180 = 0, +0x184 vector sized to the type count, +0x198 = 1. Then Setup (0x6CF20).
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x46C840..0x46CAEF, ret 0x10.

addresses.name: _A0x8295b6bf::CAreaEntry::~CAreaEntry
addresses.comment: The destructor: frees the needs vector, resets the four glues and the base. Called by the scalar deleting destructor at 0x6F9D0.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; ret 4.

addresses.name: _A0x8295b6bf::CAreaEntry::ChooseProvince
addresses.comment: **Which province names a front's row.** The front's provinces (+0x8) in list order, n of them, half = n / 2: the score of index i is 4 * (1 - |i - half| / half) + the province's +0x5C (MaxInfrastructure) / 1000, as a float, the highest strictly above 0.0 winning, first of equals. Null when no province scores above nought. Written out with a four-at-a-time unrolling of the loop.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly; DAT_0160A4F8 = 4.0, DAT_0160A248 = 1.0, local_8 zeroed at 0x46CBFC. Refuted by a province field other than +0x5C.

addresses.name: _A0x8295b6bf::CAreaEntry::Setup
addresses.comment: With the theatre and HQ found and a province chosen (+0x180 = ChooseProvince): sets the icon `theatres_continent` to the first sprite that exists of `GFX_theatres_<province id>`, then each of the province's regions in the map's order `GFX_theatres_<region name>`, then - only where the province's continent is the front enemy's acting capital's continent - `GFX_theatres_<enemy tag>`, then `GFX_theatres_continent_<continent name>`; none found leaves the file's `GFX_theatres_continent_europe`. `title` = FRONT_TITLE with $FROM$ the province's name and $TO$ the enemy's name. Attaches `goto_button` (+0x30), `build` (+0x80), `stance` (+0x120). Stores the HQ's stance (+0x208) in +0x194. Update (slot 8) once. Nothing at all when no province was chosen.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled and on the listing; FRONT_TITLE at 0x46D398.

addresses.name: _A0x8295b6bf::CAreaEntry::OnGoto
addresses.comment: `goto_button`: CentreOnProvinceId(chosen province's id), then closes the view as OnGoto of the view does. Selects nothing.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; bare ret.

addresses.name: _A0x8295b6bf::CAreaEntry::OnBuild
addresses.comment: `build`: a local = the played country's Manpower, BuildStep until false, then ShowNeeds so the row's needs and button refresh.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; bare ret.

addresses.name: _A0x8295b6bf::CAreaEntry::BuildStep
addresses.comment: One round of an area row's Build: the same order and arithmetic as CTheatreView::BuildStep (0x72120, see there), over the row's needs vector (+0x184) and the manpower local. The province of every command is the played country's +0xE24; the target is the theatre HQ's id pair.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x46D790..0x46E99D; ret 8 at 0x46DD29, 0x46E208, 0x46E99D.

addresses.name: _A0x8295b6bf::CAreaEntry::OnStance
addresses.comment: **`stance` on an area row is a label and posts nothing.** +0x194 + 1, wrapped to 0 at 5; +0x198 = 1. Nothing but this and the label reads +0x194: the row's Update reads the plan's stance, not this, so the odds do not change.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x46E9A0..0x46E9BF, the +0x194 scan over the row family finding only the constructor's write, this and the label at 0x46EAFD. Refuted by a reader of +0x194 outside this range.

addresses.name: _A0x8295b6bf::CAreaEntry::SetStanceLabel
addresses.comment: The `stance` button's text = PlanStanceName(stance), through its slot 51.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly; ret 8.

addresses.name: _A0x8295b6bf::CAreaEntry::Update
addresses.comment: Slot 8, every frame but acting only when +0x198 is set. SetStanceLabel(+0x194); builds a CList of the front's provinces and calls CUnit::UpdatePlanForceNeeds(hq, ?, ?, needs +0x184, that list); where it answers true, takes each brigade of each military line of the played country's own queue aimed at the HQ off +0x184 and ShowNeeds; otherwise `forces_needs` = NO_NEEDS_FOR_BUILDS and `build` disabled. ShowOdds(the **plan's** stance, row, the plan's power ratio); +0x198 = 0; and `current_odds` frames 1/2/3 as the theatre row. The odds are the one figure of the theatre's plan: every row of a theatre shows the same.
addresses.evidence: Read on the listing 0x46EA80..0x46F08A; the ShowOdds call site 0x46EF34..0x46EF42.

addresses.name: _A0x8295b6bf::CAreaEntry::ShowNeeds
addresses.comment: `forces_needs` = `<n> £<key>, ` over row needs above nought (database order, trailing comma off), NO_NEEDS_FOR_BUILDS when none. `build` enabled when the HQ's owner is the played country and there are needs; else disabled.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled, ret 4 at 0x46F7D5.

addresses.name: _A0x8295b6bf::CAreaEntry::ShowOdds
addresses.comment: `odds_description` = ODDS_ + DEFEND_ for stances 0-2 or ATTACK_ for 3-4 + GOOD when ratio > 750, AVERAGE when > 500, BAD otherwise.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled and on the listing; the literals; floorf(750.5)/floorf(500.5500031) at 0x160A614 and 0x160A5E8. ret 8.

addresses.name: _A0x8295b6bf::CAreaEntry::ScalarDeletingDestructor
addresses.comment: Slot 0 of CAreaEntry's table at offset 0.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; ret 4; the body the vftable holds.

addresses.name: CCountry_GetBrigadesManpowerCost
addresses.signature: CFixedPoint* __stdcall CCountry_GetBrigadesManpowerCost(CCountry* country@stack:4, CFixedPoint* out@stack:8, void* brigades@stack:0xC, int amount@stack:0x10) @EAX
addresses.comment: The manpower of a list of brigades built `amount` times over: for each CSubUnitDefinition of the CList, a throwaway regiment/wing/ship with the country's technology levels applied, its definition's BuildCostMP scaled by (country's per-type figure at technology status +0x25C + 1000)/1000, floored at g_OneTwentieth, summed; the result is sum * amount (through a float floor of (amount + 0.0005) * 1000 / 1000). Called from the build steps here and others not read.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; ret 0x10 at 0x4E1875; DAT_0160A460 = 0.0005. Whether it equals CCountry::GetBuildCostManpower's arithmetic per brigade was not compared.

addresses.name: CUnit_ObjectivesSummaryText
addresses.comment: The plan's objectives as text, empty where the plan is inactive (+0x204) or has none. Up to three: their names joined with `, ` and ` & ` before the last. Four or more: the one with the highest score - victory points * 20000 + province modifier 0xF + 1000 if it has an air base, 1000 if a naval base, 10000 if the holder's capital - as OBJ_AND_MORE with $NAME$.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; ret 8; the strings. The field names of the modifier and the buildings are the decompiler's; that the plan's objectives are the list at +0x234 of the unit was read off the unit panel callers' use and not traced further.

structs.name: CTheatreView
structs.comment: The theatres screen, the sixth of the country views. Fifteen slots, four its own (0 Rebuild, 1 ScalarDeletingDestructor, 2 Show, 6 Update). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topscreens.md, section A.
structs.evidence: RTTI export; the constructor at rva 0x6FA00.

structs.name: _A0x8295b6bf::CTheatreEntry
structs.comment: A row of the theatres screen's two lists, window `theatre_entry`.
structs.evidence: RTTI and `push 0x90` at both call sites.

structs.name: _A0x8295b6bf::CAreaEntry

struct_fields.name: close_blocked
